label: Screen share
intent: The screen goes out to the others. Light: the share arrow launches up inside the display, overshoots its raised position and settles there, and as it arrives a ripple peels off the top of the screen and rises away, fading: the display is broadcasting. Strong: the arrow dips first, launches harder with a bigger overshoot and a two-swing settle, and two ripples rise off the screen in turn. The display, stand and foot never move; the arrow holds raised. The reverse lowers the arrow without a ripple.

ripple.//: hidden at rest: the screen's top edge, scaled up and out from the frame's foot while it fades

arrow-0.//: the shaft; in Solid it is part of the head's cut-out

arrow-1.//: the head; its Solid shape is v1's whole arrow cut-out (head and shaft), knocked out of the screen

ripple.//: rises from the bottom centre of the screen

arrow.y.//: v1's end state: the arrow raised 2.4

reverse.//: stopping the share is not a broadcast: the ripple does not replay
